Rd.actsBounded_momentPoly.name: Rd.actsBounded_momentPoly
Rd.actsBounded_momentPoly.docstring:
The moment kernel polynomial `P(Y) = 1 - (-1)^L (Y - 1)^L` of a translation acts with norm at
most `1 + 2^L`.

Rd.actsBounded_addPoly.name: Rd.actsBounded_addPoly
Rd.actsBounded_addPoly.docstring: The polynomial `(-1)^L ((Y + 1)^L - 1)` of a translation acts with norm at most `2^L + 1`.

Rd.abs_sqrt_one_add_sq_sub_le.name: Rd.abs_sqrt_one_add_sq_sub_le
Rd.abs_sqrt_one_add_sq_sub_le.docstring:
**The function `t ↦ √(1 + t²)` is `1`-Lipschitz**:
`|√(1 + a²) - √(1 + b²)| ≤ |a - b|`.

Rd.abs_setAverage_sub_le.name: Rd.abs_setAverage_sub_le
Rd.abs_setAverage_sub_le.docstring:
**Averages over a subset**: if `Q ⊆ B` with `0 < |Q|` and `|B| < ∞`, and `F` is integrable
on `B`, then `|⨍_Q F - c| ≤ (|B| / |Q|) ⨍_B |F - c|` for every constant `c`.

Rd.abs_repr_sub_zcellCenter_le.name: Rd.abs_repr_sub_zcellCenter_le
Rd.abs_repr_sub_zcellCenter_le.docstring:
On a cube of level `k`, every coordinate differs from that of the centre by at most
`2^(-k)/2`.

Rd.abs_repr_le_norm.name: Rd.abs_repr_le_norm
Rd.abs_repr_le_norm.docstring: A coordinate is at most the norm.

Rd.abs_inner_mul_add_inner_halfSpaceRefl.name: Rd.abs_inner_mul_add_inner_halfSpaceReflection_mul_le
Rd.abs_inner_mul_add_inner_halfSpaceRefl.docstring:
**The reflection bound for Lipschitz functions**: for `L`-Lipschitz `φ`, a unit vector `e` and
`y ∈ H₊`, `|⟪v, e⟫ φ(y) + ⟪σ v, e⟫ φ(σ y)| ≤ 2 L |⟪v, e⟫| ⟪y, e⟫`, since `⟪σ v, e⟫ = -⟪v, e⟫`
and `‖y - σ y‖ = 2⟪y, e⟫`.

Rd.abs_deriv_smoothTransition_mul_le.name: Rd.abs_deriv_smoothTransition_mul_le
Rd.abs_deriv_smoothTransition_mul_le.docstring:
**The strip estimate**: if `|c(y)| ≤ C ⟪y, e⟫` at a point `y ∈ H₊`, then
`|s'((n + 1)⟪y, e⟫ - 1) (n + 1) c(y)| ≤ 2 D C` for a bound `D` of `|s'|`, since `s'` vanishes
unless `(n + 1)⟪y, e⟫ ≤ 2`.

Rd.abs_add_inner_le_of_norm_add_smul_le.name: Rd.abs_add_inner_le_of_norm_add_smul_le
Rd.abs_add_inner_le_of_norm_add_smul_le.docstring:
On a line in the direction of a unit vector `w`: if `‖y + t w‖ ≤ R`, then
`|t + ⟪y, w⟫| ≤ R`, since `t + ⟪y, w⟫ = ⟪y + t w, w⟫`.

Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.toContinuousLinear.name: Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.toContinuousLinearMap
Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.toContinuousLinear.docstring:
An extension operator with a finite constant as a **bounded linear operator**
(`Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.norm_apply_le`).

Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.restrictL_comp_toC.name: Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.restrictL_comp_toContinuousLinearMap
Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.restrictL_comp_toC.docstring:
**Restriction after extension is the identity** for an extension operator from `U ⊇ O`: the
restriction of `E u` to `O` has the value of `u`, hence it is `u`
(`Rd.weakSobolevJet.ext_of_fst_eq`).

Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.pasteValue.name: Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.pasteValue
Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.pasteValue.docstring:
**The values of the pasted extension**: `u ↦ ∑_k ψ_k F_k` with `F_k` the value of `E_k u`, a
linear map from the jets of `W^1_p(O)` into `L_p(V)` (`Rd.mulLp`, `Rd.mulLp_add`,
`Rd.mulLp_smul`).

Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.paste.name: Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.paste
Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.paste.docstring:
**The pasted extension operator**: for extension operators `E_k` from `O ∩ U_k` and a smooth,
compactly supported resolution of unity `(ψ_k)` on `O` subordinate to `(U_k)` with `|ψ_k| ≤ a_k`,
`|∂_{e_i} ψ_k| ≤ d_{k,i}`, the map `u ↦ ∑_k ψ_k E_k u` with the derivatives of the product rule is
an extension operator from `O` with the constant `∑_k (a_k + ∑_i d_{k,i}) C_k`
(`Rd.pasting_bound`).

Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.norm_apply_le.name: Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.norm_apply_le
Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.norm_apply_le.docstring:
The norm bound of an extension operator in the product norm of the jets:
`‖E u‖ ≤ (n + 1) C ‖u‖` for finite `C` (`Rd.prod_pi_norm_le_norm_fst_add_sum`,
`Rd.prod_pi_norm_fst_add_sum_le`).

Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.hasWeakLineDeriv_p.name: Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.hasWeakLineDeriv_pasteValue
Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.hasWeakLineDeriv_p.docstring:
**The derivatives of the pasted extension** (the product rule, `Rd.hasWeakLineDeriv_mulLp`):
`∂_{e_i} ∑_k ψ_k F_k = ∑_k (ψ_k G_{k,i} + (∂_{e_i} ψ_k) F_k)` weakly on `V`, for
`E_k u = (F_k, (G_{k,i})_i)`.

Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.extendsSobolev.name: Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.extendsSobolev
Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.extendsSobolev.docstring:
**Extension operators give extensions**: an extension operator from `U ⊆ O` extends every
`f ∈ L_p(O)` with weak derivatives `g_i ∈ L_p(O)` in the sense of `Rd.ExtendsSobolev`, applied to
the jet of the classes of `f` and `g_i`.

Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.ae_pasteValue_eq.name: Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.ae_pasteValue_eq
Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.ae_pasteValue_eq.docstring:
The pasted extension agrees with the value of the jet on `O`: `ψ_k F_k = ψ_k f` on `O` since
`F_k = f` on `O ∩ U_k ⊇ O ∩ supp ψ_k`, and `∑_k ψ_k = 1` on `O` (`Rd.ae_sum_mul_eq`).

Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.name: Rd.SobolevExtensionOp
Rd.SobolevExtensionOp.docstring:
An **extension operator for `W^1_p` from `U` with constant `C`**: a linear map `E` from the jets
of `W^1_p(O)` to the jets of `W^1_p(V)` whose values lie in `W^1_p(V)`, agree with the value of the
jet almost everywhere on `U`, and satisfy
`‖F‖_p + ∑_i ‖G_i‖_p ≤ C (‖f‖_{L_p(O)} + ∑_i ‖g_i‖_{L_p(O)})` for `E (f, g) = (F, G)`. The
condition on `U` is meant for `U ⊆ O`, the case of every use.

Rd.MemWeakSobolev.mono_set.name: Rd.MemWeakSobolev.mono_set
Rd.MemWeakSobolev.mono_set.docstring: Restriction to a smaller open set: `f ∈ W^m_p(Ω)` gives `f ∈ W^m_p(Ω')` for `Ω' ⊆ Ω`.

Rd.MemWeakSobolev.congr_ae.name: Rd.MemWeakSobolev.congr_ae
Rd.MemWeakSobolev.congr_ae.docstring:
`W^m_p(Ω)` only sees `f` almost everywhere on `Ω`: if `f ∈ W^m_p(Ω)` and `f = f'` almost
everywhere on `Ω`, then `f' ∈ W^m_p(Ω)`; the weak derivatives of `f` serve for `f'`
(`Rd.HasWeakLineDeriv.congr_ae`).

Rd.MemWeakSobolev.name: Rd.MemWeakSobolev
Rd.MemWeakSobolev.docstring:
The **Sobolev space** `W^m_p(Ω)` as a predicate: `f ∈ L_p(Ω)`, and for every order `k ≤ m`
and all directions `v = (v_0, …, v_{k-1})` the weak derivative `∂^v f` exists on `Ω` and lies in
`L_p(Ω)`.

Rd.MemTriebelLizorkinDistr.fourierMultip.name: Rd.MemTriebelLizorkinDistr.fourierMultiplierCLM
Rd.MemTriebelLizorkinDistr.fourierMultip.docstring:
**Fourier multipliers map `F^s_{p,q}` to `F^{s-σ}_{p,q}`**: for `1 < p < ∞`, `1 < q ≤ ∞`
and a symbol `m` of order `σ`, every tempered distribution `u ∈ F^s_{p,q}` has
`m(D) u ∈ F^{s-σ}_{p,q}` (`Rd.exists_triebelLizorkinNormDistr_fourierMultiplier_le`).

Rd.MemTriebelLizorkinDistr.exists_lp_blo.name: Rd.MemTriebelLizorkinDistr.exists_lp_blocks
Rd.MemTriebelLizorkinDistr.exists_lp_blo.docstring:
**The blocks of `u ∈ F^s_{p,q}` are `L_p` functions**: if the quasi-norm of `u` is finite,
there is a family `(g_j)` in `L_p(V)` with `Δ_j u = g_j` for every `j`
(`Rd.triebelLizorkinNormDistr_eq_top`).

Rd.MemTriebelLizorkinDistr.name: Rd.MemTriebelLizorkinDistr
Rd.MemTriebelLizorkinDistr.docstring:
`u ∈ F^s_{p,q}`: the Triebel–Lizorkin quasi-norm of the tempered distribution `u` is
finite.

Rd.MemTriebelLizorkin.add.name: Rd.MemTriebelLizorkin.add
Rd.MemTriebelLizorkin.add.docstring: `F^s_{p,q}` is closed under addition, for `1 ≤ q ≤ ∞`.

Rd.MemSobolevW.sum.name: Rd.MemSobolevW.sum
Rd.MemSobolevW.sum.docstring: `W^m_p(V)` is closed under finite sums in `L_p(V)` (`Rd.MemSobolevW.add`).

Rd.MemSobolevW.mulLp_of_hasCompactSuppor.name: Rd.MemSobolevW.mulLp_of_hasCompactSupport
Rd.MemSobolevW.mulLp_of_hasCompactSuppor.docstring:
**Smooth compactly supported multipliers keep `W^m_p(V)`**: if `F ∈ W^m_p(V)` and `χ` is a
smooth real function with compact support, then `χ F ∈ W^m_p(V)`. Here `hc` and `hC` are the
continuity and the bound `|χ| ≤ C` with which the product `Rd.mulLp` in `L_p` is formed; both
follow from smoothness and compact support. The derivatives along words come from the Leibniz rule
(`Rd.MemSobolevW.exists_hasWeakLineDeriv_mul`), those along all directions from the words
(`Rd.memSobolevW_of_forall_gridBasis_words`).

Rd.MemSobolevW.mulLp.name: Rd.MemSobolevW.mulLp
Rd.MemSobolevW.mulLp.docstring:
**Smooth compactly supported multipliers keep `W^1_p(V)`**: if `F ∈ W^1_p(V)` and `χ` is a
smooth real function with compact support, then `χ F ∈ W^1_p(V)`, the case `m = 1` of
`Rd.MemSobolevW.mulLp_of_hasCompactSupport`.

Rd.MemSobolevW.exists_hasWeakLineDeriv_m.name: Rd.MemSobolevW.exists_hasWeakLineDeriv_mul
Rd.MemSobolevW.exists_hasWeakLineDeriv_m.docstring:
**The Leibniz rule on `V`**: for `F ∈ W^m_p(V)` and a smooth `χ` with compact support, `χ F`
has a weak derivative `G ∈ L_p(V)` along every word of length `k ≤ m`
(`Rd.exists_hasWeakLineDeriv_mul_of_tsupport_subset` with `O = B = V`; the bound is finite since the
derivatives of `F` lie in `L_p(V)`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.upperConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.upperConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.upperConst_ne_top.docstring: The constant of the upper bound is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.upperConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.upperConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.upperConst.docstring: The constant of the upper bound, `‖m‖_1 + 2^s · 2 ‖g‖_1 (1 + R)^L`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsupport_dilate_divKer.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsupport_dilate_divKernel_subset_of_isClosed
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsupport_dilate_divKer.docstring:
**The supports of the dilated divergence kernels**: if the divergence kernel `K_i` vanishes
outside a closed set `S` with `c y ∈ S ⇒ y ∈ S` for `c ≥ 1`, then every dilate `(K_i)_{2^j}` is
supported in `S` (`Rd.tsupport_dilate_two_pow_subset`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsupport_dilate_divKer.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsupport_dilate_divKernel_subset_closedBall
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsupport_dilate_divKer.docstring:
The divergence kernels of a bump of radius `R` and their dilates `(K_i)_{2^j}` are supported
in the closed ball of radius `2R`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsum_enorm_localExtTer.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsum_enorm_localExtTerm_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsum_enorm_localExtTer.docstring:
**The sum of the norms of the terms**: if `2^(js) ‖1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ X` for every `j`, then
`∑_j ‖η_j ⋆ 1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ 2 ‖m‖_1 (1 - 2^(-s))⁻¹ X`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtTerm_le_of_forall_le`, `ENNReal.tsum_dyadicWeight_neg`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_lo.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_localExtension_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_lo.docstring:
**The local extension lies in `F^s_{p,q}`**: for `1 < p < ∞`, `1 < q ≤ ∞`, `s > 0` and a
finite local means quasi-norm of Triebel–Lizorkin type on `W`,
`‖∑_j η_j ⋆ 1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_{F^s_{p,q}} ≤ C X` with `C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlUpperConst L p q s`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_le_of_tendsto_sum_dual`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_le.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_le_tlLocalMeansNorm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_le.docstring:
**The Triebel–Lizorkin quasi-norm by local means**: for `L ≥ 1`, `1 < p < ∞`, `1 < q ≤ ∞`,
`s ∈ ℝ` and `f ∈ L_p`, `‖f‖_{F^s_{p,q}} ≤ C ‖f‖_{F^s_{p,q}}^{b,L}` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlUpperConst L p q s`, finite for `s > 0`. Pointwise the blocks are
bounded by maximal functions of the local means in `ℓ_q`, and the Fefferman–Stein inequality
bounds those in `L_p(ℓ_q)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_le.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_le_of_tendsto_sum_dual
Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_le.docstring:
**Synthesis in Triebel–Lizorkin spaces**: if `F = ∑_i η_i ⋆ h_i` in `L_p` (as the limit of
the partial sums) for a family `h_i ∈ L_p`, then for `1 < p < ∞`, `1 < q ≤ ∞` and `s ∈ ℝ`,
`‖F‖_{F^s_{p,q}} ≤ C ‖ x ↦ ‖(2^(is) |h_i(x)|)_i‖_{ℓ_q} ‖_p` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlUpperConst L p q s`, finite for `s > 0`. The blocks of `F` are bounded by
maximal functions of the `h_i`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_blockFun_le_tsum_maximalFunction_of_tendsto`), then the almost diagonal
estimate and the Fefferman–Stein inequality finish.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tl_atomic_decompositio.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tl_atomic_decomposition
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tl_atomic_decompositio.docstring:
**Atomic decomposition with `L_1`-normalised coefficients**: for `L ≥ 1`, every order `K`,
`1 ≤ p < ∞` and `F ∈ L_p`, with `g_j = k_j ⋆ F`, the coefficients
`λ_{j,m} = Rd.cellCoef 1 j g_j m = 2^(jn) ∫_{P_{j,m}} |g_j|` and the cell atoms
`a_{j,m} = Rd.cellAtom 1 η_j j g_j m = λ_{j,m}⁻¹ η_j ⋆ (1_{P_{j,m}} g_j)` with exponent one
satisfy: every `a_{j,m}` is a smooth atom on `V` of level `j` and order `K` with radius factor
`2LR + n` and constant `Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst L K`; `η_j ⋆ g_j = ∑_m λ_{j,m} a_{j,m}`
at every point; and `∑_{j ≤ J} η_j ⋆ g_j → F` in `L_p`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlUpperConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlUpperConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlUpperConst_ne_top.docstring:
The constant of the bound of the Triebel–Lizorkin quasi-norm by local means is finite for
`1 < p < ∞`, `1 < q ≤ ∞` and `s > 0`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlUpperConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlUpperConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlUpperConst.docstring:
The constant `C A_{s,L'} C_{FS}` of the bound of the Triebel–Lizorkin quasi-norm by local
means, with `L' = ⌈s⌉₊ + 1`, the natural ceiling of `s` plus one, so `L' ≥ 1` and `L' > s`:
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.blockByLocalMeansConst L L'`,
`A_{s,L'} = ENNReal.almostDiagonalConst s L'` and the Fefferman–Stein constant
`C_{FS} = Rd.feffermanSteinConst V p q`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLowerConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLowerConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLowerConst_ne_top.docstring:
The constant of the bound of the local means by the Triebel–Lizorkin quasi-norm is finite
for `1 < p < ∞`, `1 < q ≤ ∞` and `0 < s < L`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLowerConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLowerConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLowerConst.docstring:
The constant `C A_{s,L} C_{FS}` of the bound of the local means by the Triebel–Lizorkin
quasi-norm: `C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansByBlockConst L`,
`A_{s,L} = ENNReal.almostDiagonalConst s L` and `C_{FS} = Rd.feffermanSteinConst V p q`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_patch.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_patchConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_patch.docstring:
**The local means of Triebel–Lizorkin type by the gradient, with one constant**: under the
hypotheses of `Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_of_hasWeakLineDeriv`,
`‖ x ↦ ‖(2^j |1_W (k_j ⋆ F)(x)|)_j‖_{ℓ_2} ‖_p ≤ C (‖f‖_{L_p(T)} + ∑_i ‖g_i‖_{L_p(T)})` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.patchConst b p`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_of_po.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_of_pointwise
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_of_po.docstring:
**The local means of Triebel–Lizorkin type from a pointwise bound**: under the hypotheses of
`Rd.LocalMeansBump.ae_lqNorm_le_of_pointwise`, with almost everywhere strongly measurable `h_i`,
`‖ x ↦ ‖(2^{js} |1_W (k_j ⋆ F)(x)|)_j‖_{ℓ_2} ‖_p ≤ ‖m_L‖_1 ‖F‖_p +
c ∑_i ‖ x ↦ ‖(((K_i)_{2^j} ⋆ h_i)(x))_j‖_{ℓ_2} ‖_p`, with the moment kernel `m_L` of order `L`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_of_ha.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_of_hasWeakLineDeriv
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_of_ha.docstring:
**The local means of Triebel–Lizorkin type by the gradient**: let `g_i = ∂_{e_i} f` weakly on
an open set `T` with `f, g_i ∈ L_p(T)`, `1 < p < ∞`, let `x - y ∈ T` for every `x ∈ W`, every level
`j` and every `y` in the support of `(K_i)_{2^j}`, and let `F = 1_T f` in `L_p`. Then
`‖ x ↦ ‖(2^j |1_W (k_j ⋆ F)(x)|)_j‖_{ℓ_2} ‖_p ≤ ‖m‖_1 ‖f‖_{L_p(T)} +
2 ∑_i C_p(K_i) ‖g_i‖_{L_p(T)}` (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_of_pointwise`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_indicato.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_indicatorExtendLp_lt_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_indicato.docstring:
The local means quasi-norm of Triebel–Lizorkin type of a jet is finite
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_indicatorExtendLp_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_indicato.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_indicatorExtendLp_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_indicato.docstring:
**The local means of Triebel–Lizorkin type of a jet**: for a jet `u = (f, (g_i)_i)` of
`W^1_p(O)`, an open `T ⊆ O` and the support condition of
`Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn_le_patchConst`, the local means quasi-norm on `W` of `1_T f` is
at most `C_b (‖f‖_{L_p(O)} + ∑_i ‖g_i‖_{L_p(O)})`, `C_b = Rd.LocalMeansBump.patchConst b p`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn.docstring:
The **local means quasi-norm of Triebel–Lizorkin type on a set** `W`,
`‖ x ↦ ‖(2^(js) |1_W (k_j ⋆ f)(x)|)_j‖_{ℓ_q} ‖_p`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm_le_tr.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm_le_triebelLizorkinNorm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm_le_tr.docstring:
**The local means by the Triebel–Lizorkin quasi-norm**: for every order `L`, `1 < p < ∞`,
`1 < q ≤ ∞`, `s ∈ ℝ` and `f ∈ L_p`, `‖f‖_{F^s_{p,q}}^{b,L} ≤ C ‖f‖_{F^s_{p,q}}` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLowerConst L p q s`, finite for `0 < s < L`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm_le_tl.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm_le_tlDiffNorm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm_le_tl.docstring:
**The local means quasi-norm by ball means**: for every order `L`, `1 ≤ p < ∞`,
`1 ≤ q ≤ ∞`, every `s` and `f ∈ L_p`,
`‖f‖^{b,L}_{F^s_{p,q}} ≤ C (‖f‖_p + ‖(2^(js) d_j f)_j‖_{L_p(ℓ_q)})` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffLowerConst L s`. The levels `j ≤ r = ⌈R⌉₊` are bounded by Young's
inequality, the levels `j > r` by the ball means
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.lqNorm_localMean_shift_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm_le_tl.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm_le_tlCoeffNorm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm_le_tl.docstring:
**Synthesis from atoms**: for smooth atoms `a_{j,m}` on `V` of level `j` and order `L ≥ 1`
centred at the cells, with radius factor `d ≥ 0` and constant `A`, level sums
`f_j = ∑_m λ_{j,m} a_{j,m}` almost everywhere with `∑_{j ≤ J} f_j → F` in `L_p`, `1 < p < ∞`,
`1 < q ≤ ∞` and `s ∈ ℝ`,
`‖F‖_{F^s_{p,q}}^{b,L} ≤ C A_{s,L} C_{FS} ‖λ‖_{f^s_{p,q}}` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomSynthesisConst L d A`, `A_{s,L} = ENNReal.almostDiagonalConst s L`
(finite for `0 < s < L`) and the Fefferman–Stein constant `C_{FS} = Rd.feffermanSteinConst V p q`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalMeansNorm.docstring:
The **local means quasi-norm of Triebel–Lizorkin type**
`‖ x ↦ ‖(2^(js) |k_j ⋆ f(x)|)_j‖_{ℓ_q} ‖_p`, with the local means kernels `k_j` of the bump `b`
and the order `L`: the `ℓ_q` norm at each point, then the `L_p` norm.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlDiffNorm_le_tlLocalM.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlDiffNorm_le_tlLocalMeansNorm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlDiffNorm_le_tlLocalM.docstring:
**The ball means quasi-norm by local means**: for `L ≥ 1`, `1 < p < ∞`, `1 < q ≤ ∞`, every
`s` and `f ∈ L_p`, `‖f‖_p + ‖(2^(js) d_j f)_j‖_{L_p(ℓ_q)} ≤ C ‖f‖^{b,L}_{F^s_{p,q}}` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffUpperConst L p q s`, finite for `0 < s < L`. Pointwise the ball
means are bounded by maximal functions of the local means
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.ballMeanDiff_le_tsum_maximalFunction`), and the almost diagonal estimate and the
Fefferman–Stein inequality bound those in `L_p(ℓ_q)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlCoeffNorm_cellCoef_l.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlCoeffNorm_cellCoef_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlCoeffNorm_cellCoef_l.docstring:
**The coefficients of the atomic decomposition in `f^s_{p,q}`**: for every order `L`,
`1 < p < ∞`, `1 < q ≤ ∞`, `s ∈ ℝ` and `F ∈ L_p`, the coefficients with exponent one
`λ_{j,m} = Rd.cellCoef 1 j (k_j ⋆ F) m` satisfy
`‖λ‖_{f^s_{p,q}} ≤ (2n + 1)^n |B_1| C_{FS} ‖F‖_{F^s_{p,q}}^{b,L}` with the Fefferman–Stein
constant `C_{FS} = Rd.feffermanSteinConst V p q`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomSynthesisConst_n.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomSynthesisConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomSynthesisConst_n.docstring: The constant of the synthesis from atoms is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomSynthesisConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomSynthesisConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomSynthesisConst.docstring:
The constant of the synthesis of Triebel–Lizorkin spaces from atoms with radius factor `d`
and constant `A`: the larger of the constants of the coarse and of the fine local means,
`max (Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomCoarseConst L d A) (Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomFineConst L d A)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomFineConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomFineConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomFineConst_ne_top.docstring: The constant of the fine local means of atoms is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomFineConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomFineConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomFineConst.docstring:
The constant `C (d + LR + n + 1)^n |B_1|` of the fine local means of atoms with radius factor
`d` and constant `A`, with `C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentAtomConst L A` and the radius `R` of the
bump.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomCoarseConst_ne_t.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomCoarseConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomCoarseConst_ne_t.docstring: The constant of the coarse local means of atoms is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomCoarseConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomCoarseConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomCoarseConst.docstring:
The constant `C A_+ d^n |B_1| (2LR + d + n + 1)^n |B_1|` of the coarse local means of atoms
with radius factor `d` and constant `A`, where `A_+ = max(A, 0)`,
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst L` and `R` is the radius of the bump.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_mixedDualK.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_mixedDualKernel_mixedLocalMean
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_mixedDualK.docstring:
**The mixed reproducing formula**: `∑_{k ≤ J} η_k ⋆ k_k ⋆ f → f` in `L_p` over the boxes
`{k : k_i ≤ J}`, since the partial sums are `(⊗(m ⋆ m))_{2^J} ⋆ f`, an approximate identity.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_localExtTe.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_localExtTerm_of_summable
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_localExtTe.docstring: The partial sums of the local extension converge to it if its terms are summable.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_localExtTe.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_localExtTerm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_localExtTe.docstring: The partial sums of the local extension converge to it.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_dual_local.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_dual_localMean
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_dual_local.docstring:
**The reproducing formula**: `∑_j η_j ⋆ k_j ⋆ f = f` in `L_p`, since
`m_{2^J} ⋆ m_{2^J} ⋆ f → f` (`m` is an approximate identity, `Rd.tendsto_convLp_dilate`, and the
operators `m_{2^J} ⋆` are uniformly bounded, `Rd.tendsto_apply_apply_of_tendsto`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_modNorm_sub_re.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_modNorm_sub_reproducingSum
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_modNorm_sub_re.docstring:
**The reproducing formula in `B^{σ'}_{p,1}`** (approximation by continuous functions): if
`‖f‖_p + ‖(2^(kσ) ω_L(f, 2^(-k))_p)_k‖_{ℓ_q} < ∞` and `0 < σ' < σ`, `σ' < L`, then
`‖f - G_J‖_p + ∑_k 2^(kσ') ω_L(f - G_J, 2^(-k))_p → 0`: the tail
`f - G_J = ∑_{j > J} η_j ⋆ (k_j ⋆ f)` is bounded by the synthesis with the dual kernels
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_le_of_tendsto`) by
`∑_{j > J} 2^(jσ') ‖k_j ⋆ f‖_p ≤ ∑_{j > J} 2^(-j(σ - σ')) ‖(2^(iσ) ‖k_i ⋆ f‖_p)_i‖_{ℓ_q}`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_eLpNorm_ballMe.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_eLpNorm_ballMeanDiff_sub
Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_eLpNorm_ballMe.docstring:
The remainders of the reproducing formula vanish in the ball means: for `L ≥ 1`,
`1 ≤ p < ∞`, `f ∈ L_p` and every `j`, `‖d_j(f - m_{2^J} ⋆ m_{2^J} ⋆ f)‖_p → 0` as `J → ∞`,
since it is at most `2^L ‖f - m_{2^J} ⋆ m_{2^J} ⋆ f‖_p` (`Rd.eLpNorm_ballMeanDiff_le`) and
`m_{2^J} ⋆ m_{2^J} ⋆ f → f` in `L_p` (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.tendsto_sum_dual_localMean`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_of_tlLocalNormOn
Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_.docstring:
**The local extension converges absolutely** for `s > 0` and a finite local means quasi-norm
of Triebel–Lizorkin type on `W` (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_of_forall_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_of_forall_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_.docstring:
**The local extension converges absolutely** for `s > 0` if
`2^(js) ‖1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ X < ∞` for every `j`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsum_enorm_localExtTerm_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_indicatorExtendLp
Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_.docstring:
**The local extension of a jet converges absolutely**
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_of_tlLocalNormOn`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm.docstring:
**The local extension converges absolutely** for `s > 0` and a finite local means
quasi-norm on `W`: `‖η_j ⋆ 1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ 2 ‖m‖_1 2^(-js) ‖f‖_W`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_of_forall_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_lmCoeff_smul_pow.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_lmCoeff_smul_pow
Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_lmCoeff_smul_pow.docstring:
**The polynomial of one coordinate factors through a difference**: for `j ≥ 1`,
`∑_t c_j(t) Y^{ν(t)} = (Y - 1)^L (-1)^L ((Y + 1)^L - 1)`, and for `j = 0` it is `P(Y)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_dual_localMean.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_dual_localMean

Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_conv_mixedDualKern.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_conv_mixedDualKernel_mixedMeansKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_conv_mixedDualKern.docstring:
**The mixed reproducing identity of the kernels**: over the boxes `{k : k_i ≤ J}`,
`∑_k η_k ⋆ k_k = (⊗(m ⋆ m))_{2^J}`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_conv_dualKernel_me.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_conv_dualKernel_meansKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_conv_dualKernel_me.docstring:
**The reproducing identity of the kernels** in one variable:
`∑_{j ≤ J} η_j ⋆ k_j = m_{2^J} ⋆ m_{2^J}` at every point, from `(a + b) ⋆ (a - b) = a ⋆ a - b ⋆ b`
for the commuting kernels `a = m_{2^(j+1)}`, `b = m_{2^j}`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_conv_dualKernel_lo.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_conv_dualKernel_localMean_apply
Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_conv_dualKernel_lo.docstring:
**The reproducing formula at every point**: `∑_{j ≤ J} (η_j ⋆ (k_j ⋆ f))(y) =
(m_{2^J} ⋆ (m_{2^J} ⋆ f))(y)` for all `y`, since both sides are continuous and agree almost
everywhere (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_dual_localMean`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.std.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.std
Rd.LocalMeansBump.std.docstring:
The **standard bump for local means**: the normalised `ContDiffBump` around `0` with outer
radius `1`, the centred bump `Rd.LocalMeansBump.centered` of radius `1`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.sobolevExtensionOp.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.sobolevExtensionOp
Rd.LocalMeansBump.sobolevExtensionOp.docstring:
**The extension operator from one patch** (Rychkov's local extension with the local means of
the gradient): let `U ⊆ T ⊆ O` with `T` and `O` open, let the dual kernels at points of `U` only
see `W`, and let `x - y ∈ T` for every `x ∈ W`, every level `j` and every `y` in the support of
`(K_i)_{2^j}`. Then for `1 < p < ∞` the local extension of jets
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtensionJet`) with its weak derivatives (`Rd.sobolevJet.liftJet`) is an
extension operator from `U` with the constant `Rd.LocalMeansBump.bumpExtensionConst b p`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.smul_closedBall_subset.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.smul_closedBall_subset_ball
Rd.LocalMeansBump.smul_closedBall_subset.docstring: The steps `-2^(-(j+k)) z` with `‖z‖ ≤ R < 2^k` lie in the ball `B(0, 2^(-j))`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.scaledMoment_eq_zero_o.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.scaledMoment_eq_zero_of_lt
Rd.LocalMeansBump.scaledMoment_eq_zero_o.docstring: The dilated moment kernels vanish outside `B̄(0, L R 2^(-j))`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.scaledMoment_eq_zero.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.scaledMoment_eq_zero
Rd.LocalMeansBump.scaledMoment_eq_zero.docstring: The dilated moment kernels vanish outside the ball of radius `L R`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.scaledMoment.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.scaledMoment
Rd.LocalMeansBump.scaledMoment.docstring: The moment kernel at the dyadic scale `2^j`, `m_{2^j} = 2^(jn) m(2^j ·)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.reproducingSum_ae.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.reproducingSum_ae
Rd.LocalMeansBump.reproducingSum_ae.docstring: The partial sums have the continuous representatives `∑_{j ≤ J} η_j ⋆ (k_j ⋆ f)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.reproducingSum.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.reproducingSum
Rd.LocalMeansBump.reproducingSum.docstring: The partial sums of the reproducing formula, `G_J = ∑_{j ≤ J} η_j ⋆ (k_j ⋆ f)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.prod_sum_lmCoeff_eq.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.prod_sum_lmCoeff_eq
Rd.LocalMeansBump.prod_sum_lmCoeff_eq.docstring:
**The polynomial of the mixed local means factors through the mixed difference**:
`∏_i ∑_t c_{k_i}(t) δ_{w_i e_i}^{ν(t)} = B ∏_{i ∈ e(k)} (δ_{w_i e_i} - 1)^L` with the remaining
polynomial `B` (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.sum_lmCoeff_smul_pow` in each coordinate).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.patchConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.patchConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.patchConst_ne_top.docstring: The constant of the local means by the gradient is finite for `1 < p < ∞`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.patchConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.patchConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.patchConst.docstring: The constant `‖m‖_1 + 2 ∑_i C_p(K_i)` of the local means of a bump by the gradient.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.ofContDiffBump.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.ofContDiffBump
Rd.LocalMeansBump.ofContDiffBump.docstring:
**The bump for local means of a smooth bump function**: the mollifier of a smooth bump `f`
around `c` with outer radius `r_out` vanishes outside `B̄(c, r_out)`, hence outside the ball of
every radius `R ≥ ‖c‖ + r_out` around `0`, since `‖z‖ ≤ ‖z - c‖ + ‖c‖`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.norm_meansKernel_le.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.norm_meansKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.norm_meansKernel_le.docstring:
**The local means kernels are bounded**: `|k_j(y)| ≤ C 2^(jn)` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst L`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.norm_iteratedFDeriv_mo.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.norm_iteratedFDeriv_momentKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.norm_iteratedFDeriv_mo.docstring:
The derivatives of order `l ≤ K` of the moment kernel `m` are bounded by the sum of the
suprema `∑_{i ≤ K} sup ‖D^i m‖`, its Schwartz seminorms.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.norm_iteratedFDeriv_du.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.norm_iteratedFDeriv_dualKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.norm_iteratedFDeriv_du.docstring:
**Derivatives of the dual kernels**: `‖D^l η_j‖ ≤ A 2^(j(n+l))` for `l ≤ K` and every level
`j`, with the explicit constant `A = Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst L K`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentSchwartz.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentSchwartz
Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentSchwartz.docstring: The moment kernel of a bump as a Schwartz function.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentKernel_two_eq_ze.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentKernel_two_eq_zero
Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentKernel_two_eq_ze.docstring:
The moment kernel of order two of a bump of radius `R` vanishes outside the ball of radius
`2R`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentKernel_eq_zero.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentKernel_eq_zero
Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentKernel_eq_zero.docstring: The moment kernel of a bump vanishes outside the ball of radius `L R`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentConst_ne_top.docstring:
The constant `‖m‖_1 + 2 ‖g‖_1` of the bounds of the local means by the moduli on a set
(`Rd.LipschitzGraph.intrinsicConst` for the cone bump, `Rd.LocalMeansBump.localNormOn_le`) is
finite, for the moment kernel `m` of the bump `g` (`Rd.eLpNorm_momentKernel_ne_top`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentAtomConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentAtomConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentAtomConst_ne_top.docstring: The constant of the fine local means of a smooth atom is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentAtomConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentAtomConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.momentAtomConst.docstring:
The constant `2 ‖g‖_1 2^L L^(L+1) A (2R)^L` of the fine local means of a smooth atom of order
`L` and constant `A`, for the bump `g` of radius `R`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_reproducingSum.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_reproducingSum_lt_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_reproducingSum.docstring:
**The partial sums have finite norms**: `‖G_J‖_p + ‖(2^(kσ) ω_L(G_J, 2^(-k))_p)_k‖_{ℓ_q} < ∞`
for `0 < σ < L`, by the synthesis with the dual kernels for finitely many terms.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_localExtension.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_localExtension_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_localExtension.docstring:
**The local extension satisfies the Besov condition by differences**: for `0 < s`,
`‖F‖_p + ‖(2^(is) ω_L(F, 2^(-i))_p)_i‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ C ‖(2^(js) ‖1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p)_j‖_{ℓ_q}`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_le_of_tendsto.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_le_of_tendsto
Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_le_of_tendsto.docstring:
**Synthesis with the dual kernels**: if `F = ∑_j η_j ⋆ h_j` in `L_p` (as the limit of the
partial sums), then for `0 < s < L`,
`‖F‖_p + ‖(2^(is) ω_L(F, 2^(-i))_p)_i‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ C ‖(2^(js) ‖h_j‖_p)_j‖_{ℓ_q}`, by the bound of a
convergent series by its weighted terms (`ENNReal.enorm_le_of_tendsto_sum`), the moduli of the
terms (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.lpModulus_dual_le`) and Hardy's inequalities.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedModNorm_le_of_ten.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedModNorm_le_of_tendsto
Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedModNorm_le_of_ten.docstring:
**Synthesis with the mixed dual kernels**: if `F = ∑_k η_k ⋆ h_k` as the limit of the partial
sums over the boxes `{k : k_i ≤ J}`, then for `0 ≤ s`,
`‖(2^(s|m|_1) Ω^{e(m)}_L(F, 2^(-m))_p)_m‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ (C_η C)^d ‖(2^(s|k|_1) ‖h_k‖_p)_k‖_{ℓ_q}` with the
constant `C` of the almost diagonal lemma, finite for `0 < s < L`
(`Rd.lqNorm_le_of_le_almostDiagonal_pi`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedModNorm_le_mixedL.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedModNorm_le_mixedLocalMeansNorm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedModNorm_le_mixedL.docstring:
**The mixed modulus is bounded by the mixed local means**: for `0 ≤ s`,
`‖(2^(s|m|_1) Ω^{e(m)}_L(f, 2^(-m))_p)_m‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ (C_η C)^d ‖(2^(s|k|_1) ‖k_k ⋆ f‖_p)_k‖_{ℓ_q}`, by
the mixed reproducing formula and the synthesis.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMeansNorm_le.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMeansNorm_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMeansNorm_le.docstring:
**Local means quasi-norm and differences**:
`‖(2^(s|k|_1) ‖k_k ⋆ f‖_p)_k‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ (‖g‖_1 (2^L + 1))^d ‖(2^(s|k|_1) Ω^{e(k)}_L(f, 2^(-k))_p)_k‖_{ℓ_q}`
for a bump vanishing outside `[-1, 1]`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMeansNorm.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMeansNorm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMeansNorm.docstring: The **mixed local means quasi-norm** `‖(2^(s|k|_1) ‖k_k ⋆ f‖_p)_{k ∈ ℕ^d}‖_{ℓ_q(ℕ^d)}`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMean_ae_eq.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMean_ae_eq
Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMean_ae_eq.docstring:
**Mixed local means average translates**: for almost every `x`,
`k_k ⋆ f(x) = ∫ (⊗g)(z) A(z) f(x) dz` with the polynomial
`A(z) = ∏_i ∑_t c_{k_i}(t) δ_{-z_i 2^(-k_i) e_i}^{ν(t)}` in the translations
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_eq_sum_dilate`, `Rd.conv_tensorKernel_sum_dilate_ae`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMean.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMean
Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMean.docstring: The **mixed local means** `f ↦ k_k ⋆ f` on `L_p(ℝ^d)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.memTriebelLizorkin_loc.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.memTriebelLizorkin_localExtension_of_tlLocalNormOn
Rd.LocalMeansBump.memTriebelLizorkin_loc.docstring:
**The local extension lies in `F^1_{p,2}(V)`** if the local means quasi-norm of
Triebel–Lizorkin type of `F` on `W` is finite
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.triebelLizorkinNorm_localExtension_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.memTriebelLizorkin_loc.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.memTriebelLizorkin_localExtensionJet
Rd.LocalMeansBump.memTriebelLizorkin_loc.docstring:
The local extension of a jet lies in `F^1_{p,2}(V)`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.memTriebelLizorkin_localExtension_of_tlLocalNormOn`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.measurable_dyadicWeigh.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.measurable_dyadicWeight_mul_conv_meansKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.measurable_dyadicWeigh.docstring: The weighted local means `2^(js) |k_j ⋆ f|` are measurable.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_two_succ.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_two_succ
Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_two_succ.docstring:
**The local means kernels of order two at dyadic scales**: `k_{j+1} = (m_2 - m)_{2^j}`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_succ_eq_dilate`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_succ_eq_di.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_succ_eq_dilate
Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_succ_eq_di.docstring:
**The local means kernels at dyadic scales**: for a bump with moment kernel `m` of order `L`,
`k_{j+1} = (m_2 - m)_{2^j}`, since `k_{j+1} = m_{2^(j+1)} - m_{2^j}` and
`(m_2)_{2^j} = m_{2^(j+1)}` (`Rd.dilate_sub`, `Rd.dilate_dilate`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_eq_zero_of.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_eq_zero_of_lt
Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_eq_zero_of.docstring: The local means kernels vanish outside `B̄(0, 2 L R 2^(-j))`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_eq_sum_dil.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_eq_sum_dilate
Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_eq_sum_dil.docstring:
**The local means kernels are sums of dilated bumps**:
`k_j = ∑_l a_l (g_{2^j/(l+1)} - g_{2^j/(2(l+1))})` for `j ≥ 1` and `k_0 = ∑_l a_l g_{1/(l+1)}`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel.docstring: The **local means kernels** `k_0 = m`, `k_j = m_{2^j} - m_{2^(j-1)}`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.maximalFunction_enorm_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.maximalFunction_enorm_localMean
Rd.LocalMeansBump.maximalFunction_enorm_.docstring:
The maximal function of a local mean is that of the pointwise convolution `k_i ⋆ f`
(`Rd.maximalFunction_congr_ae`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lqNorm_localMean_shift.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lqNorm_localMean_shift_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lqNorm_localMean_shift.docstring:
**The fine local means by ball means in `ℓ_q`**: with `r = ⌈R⌉₊`, almost everywhere,
`‖(2^((j+r+1)s) |k_{j+r+1} ⋆ f(x)|)_j‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ 2^((r+1)s) C ‖(2^(js) d_j f(x))_j‖_{ℓ_q}` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.ballMeanConst` (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_le_ballMeanDiff`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lqNorm_localMean_le_lq.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lqNorm_localMean_le_lqNorm_maximalFunction
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lqNorm_localMean_le_lq.docstring:
**The local means by blocks in `ℓ_q`**: for every order `L`, `1 ≤ p < ∞`, `1 ≤ q ≤ ∞`,
`s ∈ ℝ` and `f ∈ L_p`, almost everywhere,
`‖(2^(js) |k_j ⋆ f(x)|)_j‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ C A_{s,L} ‖(M(2^(is) |ψ_i ⋆ f|)(x))_i‖_{ℓ_q}` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansByBlockConst L` and `A_{s,L} = ENNReal.almostDiagonalConst s L`,
finite for `0 < s < L`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lqNorm_blockFun_le_lqN.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lqNorm_blockFun_le_lqNorm_maximalFunction
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lqNorm_blockFun_le_lqN.docstring:
**The blocks by local means in `ℓ_q`**: for `L ≥ 1`, `L' ≥ 1`, `1 ≤ p < ∞`, `1 ≤ q ≤ ∞`,
`s ∈ ℝ` and `f ∈ L_p`, almost everywhere,
`‖(2^(js) |ψ_j ⋆ f(x)|)_j‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ C A_{s,L'} ‖(M(2^(is) |k_i ⋆ f|)(x))_i‖_{ℓ_q}` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.blockByLocalMeansConst L L'` and
`A_{s,L'} = ENNReal.almostDiagonalConst s L'`, finite for `0 < s < L'`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lpModulus_dual_le.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lpModulus_dual_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lpModulus_dual_le.docstring:
**The moduli of the reproducing terms**: for `η_j ⋆ h`,
`ω_L(η_j ⋆ h, 2^(-i))_p ≤ C c_{ij} ‖h‖_p` with `c_{ij} = 2^(-(i-j)L)` for `j ≤ i` and `1` for
`j > i`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lpMixedModulus_convLp_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lpMixedModulus_convLp_mixedDualKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lpMixedModulus_convLp_.docstring:
**The mixed moduli of the reproducing terms**:
`Ω^{e(m)}_L(η_k ⋆ h, 2^(-m))_p ≤ C_η^d ∏_i c(m_i, k_i) ‖h‖_p`, by the differences of the
one-dimensional dual kernels in `L_1` (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_higherDiff_dualKernel_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lpBlock_sum_dualKernel.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lpBlock_sum_dualKernel_ae
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lpBlock_sum_dualKernel.docstring:
**A block of a partial synthesis sum**: for every family `h_i ∈ L_p`, almost everywhere,
`Δ_j (∑_{i ≤ J} η_i ⋆ h_i) = ∑_{i ≤ J} (ψ_j ⋆ η_i) ⋆ h_i`, with pointwise convolutions on the
right.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localNormOn_le.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localNormOn_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localNormOn_le.docstring:
**The local means on `W` are bounded by the moduli on `T`**:
`‖(2^(js) ‖1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p)_j‖_{ℓ_q} ≤
(‖m‖_1 + 2 ‖g‖_1) (‖f‖_p + ‖(2^(js) ω_L(f, 2^(-j), T)_p)_j‖_{ℓ_q})`
(`ENNReal.lqNorm_dyadicWeight_le_of_head_of_succ_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localNormOn.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localNormOn
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localNormOn.docstring: The **local means quasi-norm on a set** `‖(2^(js) ‖1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p)_j‖_{ℓ_q}`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansNorm_le.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansNorm_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansNorm_le.docstring:
**The local means quasi-norm is bounded by the modulus**:
`‖(2^(js) ‖k_j ⋆ f‖_p)_j‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ C (‖f‖_p + ‖(2^(js) ω_L(f, 2^(-j))_p)_j‖_{ℓ_q})`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansByBlockConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansByBlockConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansByBlockConst.docstring: The constant of the bound of the local means by blocks is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansByBlockConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansByBlockConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansByBlockConst.docstring:
The constant `C^Θ_{L,n+1} C_{n,n+1}` of the bound of the local means by blocks: the constant
of the cross kernels `k_j ⋆ Θ_i` (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossBandConst`) at the decay order
`n + 1` times the constant of the maximal function bound (`Rd.decayMaximalConst`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMean_sum_lpBlock_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMean_sum_lpBlock_ae
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMean_sum_lpBlock_.docstring:
**A local mean of a partial sum of blocks**: almost everywhere,
`k_j ⋆ (∑_{i < J} Δ_i f) = ∑_{i < J} (k_j ⋆ Θ_i) ⋆ (ψ_i ⋆ f)`, with pointwise convolutions on
the right.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMean_lpBlock.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMean_lpBlock
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMean_lpBlock.docstring:
A local mean of a block is the block convolved with the cross kernel:
`k_j ⋆ Δ_i f = (k_j ⋆ Θ_i) ⋆ Δ_i f` in `L_p`, since `Θ_i ⋆ ψ_i = ψ_i`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMean_ae_eq.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMean_ae_eq
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMean_ae_eq.docstring: The local means `k_j ⋆ f ∈ L_p` are represented by the pointwise convolutions.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtensionJet.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtensionJet
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtensionJet.docstring:
**The local extension of jets**: `u = (f, (g_i)_i) ↦ ∑_j η_j ⋆ 1_W (k_j ⋆ 1_T f)`, a linear
map from the jets of `W^1_p(O)` into `L_p(V)`; the series converges for every jet
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.summable_localExtTerm_indicatorExtendLp`), so it is additive.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtTerm_smul.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtTerm_smul
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtTerm_smul.docstring: The terms of the local extension commute with complex scalars.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtTerm_add.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtTerm_add
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtTerm_add.docstring: The terms of the local extension are additive in `f`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtTerm.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtTerm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtTerm.docstring: The terms `η_j ⋆ 1_W (k_j ⋆ f)` of the local extension.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtConst_ne_top.docstring: The constant of the local extension is finite for `0 < s < L`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtConst.docstring:
The **constant of the local extension** `C_b(L, s) (‖m‖_1 + 2 ‖g‖_1)`, for the moment kernel
`m` of the bump `g`: the constant of the synthesis estimate (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.bumpSynthConst`)
times that of `Rd.LocalMeansBump.localNormOn_le`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lmRemainder.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lmRemainder
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lmRemainder.docstring:
The **remaining polynomial** of the mixed local means at the steps `w`:
`∏_i b_i(δ_{w_i e_i})` with `b(Y) = 1 - (-1)^L (Y - 1)^L` in the coordinates with `k_i = 0` and
`b(Y) = (-1)^L ((Y + 1)^L - 1)` in the others.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lmExp.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lmExp
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lmExp.docstring: The exponents of the local means kernels: `l + 1` and `2(l + 1)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lmCoeff.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lmCoeff
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lmCoeff.docstring:
The coefficients of the local means kernel `k_j`: `a_l` at `Y^(l+1)`, and `-a_l` at
`Y^(2(l+1))` for `j ≥ 1`, with the coefficients `a_l = (-1)^l C(L, l + 1)` of the moment
kernels.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_lpKernel_mul.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_lpKernel_mul_higherDiff_dualKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_lpKernel_mul.docstring:
**The averaged differences of `η_i`**, integrated: if the differences
`Δ^L'_{-2^(-j') z} η_i(w)` vanish for `‖z‖ < ρ`, then
`∫ |Φ(z)| |Δ^L'_{-2^(-j') z} η_i(w)| dz ≤ A 2^(in) 2^(iL') 2^(-j'L') T (1 + ρ)^(-N)` with
`A = Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst L L'` and `T = Rd.tailConst lpKernelS L' N`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_enorm_mul_hi.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_enorm_mul_higherDiff_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_enorm_mul_hi.docstring:
**One averaged difference by a ball mean**: for the bump `b`, `R < 2^k`, every `f`, `x`
and `j`, `∫ |b(z)| |Δ^L_{-2^(-(j+k)) z} f(x)| dz ≤ sup |b| |B(0,1)| 2^(kn) d_j f(x)`. The steps
`-2^(-(j+k)) z`, `‖z‖ ≤ R`, fill a ball inside `B(0, 2^(-j))`, and the change of variables
`h = -2^(-(j+k)) z` (`Rd.setLIntegral_comp_smul`) costs the factor `2^((j+k)n)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_enorm_meansK.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_enorm_meansKernel_mul_atom_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_enorm_meansK.docstring:
**A coarse local mean of an atom**: for levels `i ≤ j` and a smooth atom `a` on `V` of level
`j` with centre `c`, radius factor `d ≥ 0` and constant `A`,
`∫ |k_i(y)| |a(x - y)| dy ≤ C A d^n |B_1| 2^(in) 2^(-jn)` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst L`, and the integral vanishes unless
`|x - c| ≤ (2LR + d) 2^(-i)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_dilatedBandK.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_dilatedBandKernel_mul_meansKernel_le_near
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_dilatedBandK.docstring:
The support case near the origin: for `‖y‖ ≤ 4LR 2^(-j)`,
`∫ |Θ_i(z)| |k_j(y - z)| dz ≤ C ‖Θ‖_1 (1 + 4LR)^N 2^(jn) (1 + 2^j ‖y‖)^(-N)` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst L`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_dilatedBandK.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_dilatedBandKernel_mul_meansKernel_le_far
Rd.LocalMeansBump.lintegral_dilatedBandK.docstring:
The support case far from the origin: for `j ≤ i` and `‖y‖ > 4LR 2^(-j)`,
`∫ |Θ_i(z)| |k_j(y - z)| dz ≤ C 2^N T 2^(jn) (1 + 2^j ‖y‖)^(-N)` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst L` and `T = Rd.tailConst bandKernelS 0 N`: the integrand
vanishes unless `‖z‖ ≥ ‖y‖ / 2`, where the tail of `Θ_i` is small.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.laverage_enorm_conv_du.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.laverage_enorm_conv_dualKernel_add_smul_le_of_one_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.laverage_enorm_conv_du.docstring:
**Averages of shifted `η_i ⋆ g`**: for `j ≤ i`, `1 ≤ l ≤ L`, a locally integrable `g` and
every `x`, `⨍_B |η_i ⋆ g(x + l h)| dh ≤ A_0 (2LR + 1)^n (2LR + L + 1)^n |B(0,1)| M|g|(x)`
with `B = B(0, 2^(-j))`: the bound of `|η_i ⋆ g|` by integrals of `|g|` over moving balls
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_dualKernel_le`) and the average of those balls
(`Rd.setLIntegral_setLIntegral_ball_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.laverage_enorm_conv_du.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.laverage_enorm_conv_dualKernel_add_smul_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.laverage_enorm_conv_du.docstring:
**Averages of shifted `η_i ⋆ g`, every shift**: for `j ≤ i`, `l ≤ L`, a locally integrable
`g` and every `x`,
`⨍_B |η_i ⋆ g(x + l h)| dh ≤ A_0 (2LR + 1)^n (2LR + L + 1)^n |B(0,1)| M|g|(x)` with
`B = B(0, 2^(-j))`; for `l = 0` the integrand is constant
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_dualKernel_le_maximalFunction`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst_nonneg.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst_nonneg
Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst_nonneg.docstring: The constant of the local means kernels is nonnegative.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.kernelSupConst.docstring:
The constant `2 sup |m|` of the local means kernels, with the supremum of the moment kernel
`m` as its Schwartz seminorm.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.isSmoothAtom_cellAtom.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.isSmoothAtom_cellAtom
Rd.LocalMeansBump.isSmoothAtom_cellAtom.docstring:
**Cell atoms of the dual kernels are smooth atoms of every order**: every cell atom of
`η_j ⋆ g`, `g ∈ L_p`, is a smooth atom on `V` of order `K`, radius factor `2LR + n` and constant
`A ((2LR)^n |B_1|)^(1-1/p)` with `A = Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst L K`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.isCZFamily_divKernel.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.isCZFamily_divKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.isCZFamily_divKernel.docstring:
**The divergence kernels form Calderón–Zygmund families**: the dilates `(K_i)_{2^j}` have the
Fourier overlap `Rd.meanZeroOverlap (K_i)` and the Hörmander constant `4 H_{K_i}`
(`Rd.isCZFamily_divergenceSchwartz`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.integral_inner_mul_mom.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.integral_inner_mul_momentKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.integral_inner_mul_mom.docstring:
**The moment kernel of order two of a bump has vanishing first moments**
(`Rd.integral_inner_mul_momentKernel_two`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.integral_conv_momentKe.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.integral_conv_momentKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.integral_conv_momentKe.docstring: The convolution `m ⋆ m` of the moment kernel has integral `1`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.integrable_scaledMomen.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.integrable_scaledMoment
Rd.LocalMeansBump.integrable_scaledMomen.docstring: The dilated moment kernels are integrable.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.integrable_mixedDualKe.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.integrable_mixedDualKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.integrable_mixedDualKe.docstring: The mixed dual kernels are integrable.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.integrable_meansKernel.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.integrable_meansKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.integrable_meansKernel.docstring: The local means kernels are integrable.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.indicatorLp_localExten.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.indicatorLp_localExtension_of_summable
Rd.LocalMeansBump.indicatorLp_localExten.docstring:
**The local extension agrees with `f` on `U`** if its terms are summable and the dual kernels
at points of `U` only see `W`: on `U` the terms are those of the reproducing formula.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.indicatorLp_localExten.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.indicatorLp_localExtension
Rd.LocalMeansBump.indicatorLp_localExten.docstring:
**The local extension agrees with `f` on `U`** if the dual kernels at points of `U` only see
`W`: on `U` the terms are those of the reproducing formula.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.iSup_enorm_lt_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.iSup_enorm_lt_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.iSup_enorm_lt_top.docstring:
The supremum `sup |b|` of a bump `b` is finite, since a bump is continuous with compact
support.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.higherDiff_dualKernel_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.higherDiff_dualKernel_eq_zero_of_norm_lt
Rd.LocalMeansBump.higherDiff_dualKernel_.docstring:
For `L' ≥ 1` and `‖w‖ > 4LR 2^(-i)`, the difference `Δ^L'_{-2^(-j') z} η_i(w)` vanishes
whenever `‖z‖ < 2^j' ‖w‖ / (2L')`: all points `w - l 2^(-j') z`, `l ≤ L'`, then lie outside
`B̄(0, 2LR 2^(-i))`, where `η_i` vanishes.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.higherDiff_dualKernel_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.higherDiff_dualKernel_eq_zero
Rd.LocalMeansBump.higherDiff_dualKernel_.docstring:
**Support of the differences of the dual kernels**: `Δ^L'_h η_i(w) = 0` for
`‖w‖ > 2LR 2^(-i) + L' ‖h‖`, since all points `w + l h`, `l ≤ L'`, lie outside the support of
`η_i`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_scal.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_scaledMoment
Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_scal.docstring: The dilated moment kernels have compact support.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_mome.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_momentKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_mome.docstring: The moment kernel of a bump has compact support.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_mean.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_meansKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_mean.docstring: The local means kernels have compact support.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_dual.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_dualKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_dual.docstring: The dual kernels have compact support.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_divK.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_divKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.hasCompactSupport_divK.docstring: The divergence kernels of a bump have compact support.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.gradientConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.gradientConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.gradientConst_ne_top.docstring: The constant of the gradient bound is finite for `1 < p < ∞`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.gradientConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.gradientConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.gradientConst.docstring:
The constant `∑_i C_{p}(K_i)` of the gradient bound of the local means, with the constants
`C_p(K_i) = Rd.czConst V p B_i H_i` of the Calderón–Zygmund families of the divergence kernels
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.isCZFamily_divKernel`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_momentKernel_ne.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_momentKernel_ne_zero_of_divKernel_ne_zero
Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_momentKernel_ne.docstring:
If a divergence kernel is nonzero at `y`, the moment kernel is nonzero at some `t y` with
`t ∈ [1, 2]` (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.divKernel_eq_zero`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_mixedLocalMeans.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_mixedLocalMeansNorm_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_mixedLocalMeans.docstring:
**The mixed local means are bounded by the Littlewood–Paley blocks**: there is `C < ∞` with
`‖(2^(s|m|_1) ‖k_m ⋆ f‖_p)_m‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ (C C_s)^d ‖(2^(s|k|_1) ‖δ_k ⋆ f‖_p)_k‖_{ℓ_q}` for `0 ≤ s`
(`Rd.lqNorm_le_of_le_almostDiagonal_pi`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_mixedLPNorm_le.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_mixedLPNorm_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_mixedLPNorm_le.docstring:
**Littlewood–Paley blocks are bounded by the mixed local means**: there is `C < ∞` with
`‖(2^(s|m|_1) ‖δ_m ⋆ f‖_p)_m‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ (C C_s)^d ‖(2^(s|k|_1) ‖k_k ⋆ f‖_p)_k‖_{ℓ_q}` for `0 ≤ s`,
`C_s` the constant of the almost diagonal lemma (`Rd.lqNorm_le_of_le_almostDiagonal_pi`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_local_extension.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_local_extension_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_local_extension.docstring:
**The local extension theorem with a bound**: let `U ⊆ W`, `U ⊆ T` be measurable sets such
that the dual kernels at points of `U` only see `W` and the steps take `W` into `T`, and let the
bump have radius `R ≤ 1/2`. For `1 ≤ p < ∞`, `0 < s`, `1 ≤ q ≤ ∞` and `f` with
`N_T(f) = ‖f‖_{L_p(T)} + ‖(2^(ks) ω_L(f, 2^(-k), T)_p)_k‖_{ℓ_q} < ∞` there is `F` with
`F = f` almost everywhere on `U` and
`‖F‖_p + ‖(2^(ks) ω_L(F, 2^(-k))_p)_k‖_{ℓ_q} ≤ C_b(L, s) (‖m‖_1 + 2 ‖g‖_1) N_T(f)`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtConst`): the local extension of `1_T f`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.modNorm_localExtension_le`, `Rd.LocalMeansBump.localNormOn_le`). The constant
is finite for `s < L` (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.localExtConst_ne_top`); for `s ≥ L` the factor
`(1 - 2^(-(L - s)))⁻¹` of `Rd.LocalMeansBump.bumpSynthConst` is `∞`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_isSmoothAtom_ce.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_isSmoothAtom_cellAtom
Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_isSmoothAtom_ce.docstring:
**Cell atoms of the dual kernels are smooth atoms of every order**: for every order `K` there
is `A` such that every cell atom of `η_j ⋆ g`, `g ∈ L_p`, is a smooth atom on `V` of order `K`,
radius factor `2LR + n` and constant `A`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_higherDiff_dual.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_higherDiff_dualKernel_bound
Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_higherDiff_dual.docstring:
**Pointwise bounds of the dual kernels**: for every order `r` there is `A < ∞` with
`|Δ_h^l η_j| ≤ A 2^(jn) min(1, (2^j ‖h‖)^l)` for `l ≤ r`, from the bounded derivatives of the
moment kernel (`Rd.enorm_higherDiff_le_of_iteratedFDeriv`) and the scaling of differences of
dilations (`Rd.higherDiff_dilate`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_eLpNorm_conv_me.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_eLpNorm_conv_meansKernel_dilatedBandKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_eLpNorm_conv_me.docstring:
**Local means kernels against the band-limiting kernels**: there is `C < ∞` with
`‖k_m ⋆ Θ_k‖_1 ≤ C c(m, k)`. For `k < m`, `‖k_m ⋆ Θ_k‖_1 ≤ C ω_L(Θ_k, 2^(1-m))_1` and the
differences of `Θ_k` give `2^(-(m-1-k)L)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_eLpNorm_conv_lp.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_eLpNorm_conv_lpBlockKernel_dualKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_eLpNorm_conv_lp.docstring:
**Littlewood–Paley blocks against the dual kernels**: there is `C < ∞` with
`‖ψ_m ⋆ η_k‖_1 ≤ C c(m, k)`, `c(m, k) = 2^(-(m-k)L)` for `k ≤ m` and `1` for `k > m`. For
`k + 3 ≤ m`, `ψ_m` annihilates the band-limited Jackson approximant `J_{m-3} η_k`, and
`‖η_k - J_{m-3} η_k‖_1 ≤ C ω_L(η_k, 2^(-(m-3)))_1 ≤ C 2^(-(m-3-k)L)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_cellAtom_pointw.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_cellAtom_pointwise_bound
Rd.LocalMeansBump.exists_cellAtom_pointw.docstring:
**Uniform pointwise bounds of the cell atoms**: for every order `r` there is `A < ∞` such that
the cell atoms of `η_j ⋆ g`, `g ∈ L_p`, satisfy `|Δ_h^l a_{j,m}| ≤ A min(1, (2^j ‖h‖)^l)` for all
`l ≤ r`, `j`, `m`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mul_higherDiff_d.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mul_higherDiff_dilatedBandKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mul_higherDiff_d.docstring:
One step of the moment case, pointwise in `z`: for `i ≤ k`,
`|g(z)| |Δ^L_{-2^(-k) z} Θ_i(y)| ≤ |g(z)| C R^L 2^(-(k-i)L) (1 + L R)^N 2^(in) (1 + 2^i ‖y‖)^(-N)`
with `C = Rd.schwartzDecayConst bandKernelS L N`, since the step of the dilated difference has
length `2^(i-k) ‖z‖ ≤ 2^(i-k) R` on the support of the bump `g`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mul_higherDiff_a.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mul_higherDiff_atom_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mul_higherDiff_a.docstring:
One step of the moment identity for an atom, pointwise in `z`: for a smooth atom `a` on `V`
of level `j` and order `L ≥ 1` with centre `c`, radius factor `d` and constant `A`, and `k ≥ j`,
`|g(z)| |Δ^L_{-2^(-k) z} a(x)| ≤ |g(z)| 2^L L^(L+1) A R^L 2^(-(k-j)L) 1_{|x - c| ≤ (d + LR) 2^(-j)}`
for the bump `g` of radius `R`: on the support of `g` the step has length at most `2^(-k) R`, and
far from `c` the differences vanish (`Rd.IsSmoothAtom.higherDiff_eq_zero_of_lt`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mixedLocalMean_m.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mixedLocalMean_mixedBlock_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mixedLocalMean_m.docstring:
One term of the comparison: `‖k_m ⋆ δ_k ⋆ f‖_p ≤ C^d ∏_i c(m_i, k_i) ‖δ_k ⋆ f‖_p` if
`‖k_m ⋆ Θ_k‖_1 ≤ C c(m, k)` in one variable, since `δ_k = (⊗Θ_{k_i}) ⋆ δ_k`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mixedLocalMean_l.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mixedLocalMean_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mixedLocalMean_l.docstring:
**Mixed local means are bounded by the mixed modulus**: if the bump `g` vanishes outside
`[-1, 1]`, then `‖k_k ⋆ f‖_p ≤ (‖g‖_1 (2^L + 1))^d Ω^{e(k)}_L(f, 2^(-k))_p`. The tensor kernel
averages `B(z) Δ^{L,e(k)}_{h(z)} f` with `h(z)_i = -z_i/2^(k_i)` over `(⊗g)(z) dz`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.mixedLocalMean_ae_eq`, `Rd.LocalMeansBump.prod_sum_lmCoeff_eq`), where the
remaining polynomials `B(z)` act with norm at most `(2^L + 1)^d`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.actsBounded_lmRemainder`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mixedBlock_convL.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mixedBlock_convLp_mixedDualKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_mixedBlock_convL.docstring:
One term of the comparison: `‖δ_m ⋆ η_k ⋆ h‖_p ≤ C^d ∏_i c(m_i, k_i) ‖h‖_p` if
`‖ψ_m ⋆ η_k‖_1 ≤ C c(m, k)` in one variable.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_succ_l.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_succ_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_succ_l.docstring:
**Local means are bounded by the modulus**:
`‖k_{j+1} ⋆ f‖_p ≤ 2 ‖g‖_1 (1 + R)^L ω_L(f, 2^(-j))_p`, since
`k_{j+1} ⋆ f = (f - m_{2^j} ⋆ f) - (f - m_{2^(j+1)} ⋆ f)` and `f - m_c ⋆ f` averages differences
with steps of length at most `R/c`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_le_tsu.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_le_tsum_maximalFunction_cellCoefFun
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_le_tsu.docstring:
**Local means of an atomic sum, pointwise**: for smooth atoms `a_{j,m}` on `V` of level `j`
and order `L ≥ 1` centred at the cells, with radius factor `d ≥ 0` and constant `A`, level
sums `f_j = ∑_m λ_{j,m} a_{j,m}` almost everywhere and `∑_{j ≤ J} f_j → F` in `L_p`,
`1 ≤ p < ∞`, almost everywhere and for all `i`,
`|k_i ⋆ F(x)| ≤ C ∑_j c_{ij} M_j(x)` with `c_{ij} = 2^(-(i-j)L)` for `j ≤ i`, `c_{ij} = 1` for
`j > i`, `M_j` the maximal function of the step function of the coefficients of level `j` and
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomSynthesisConst L d A`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_le_tsu.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_le_tsum_maximalFunction
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_le_tsu.docstring:
**The local means by blocks, pointwise**: for every order `L`, `1 ≤ p < ∞` and `f ∈ L_p`,
almost everywhere and for all levels `j`, `|k_j ⋆ f(x)| ≤ C ∑_i c_{ji} M(ψ_i ⋆ f)(x)` with
`c_{ji} = 2^(-(j-i)L)` for `i ≤ j`, `c_{ji} = 1` for `i > j`, and
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansByBlockConst L`. The decomposition `f = ∑_i Δ_i f` holds in
`L_p`, and the bound passes from its partial sums to `f`
(`MeasureTheory.ae_enorm_le_of_tendsto_Lp`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_le_bal.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_le_ballMeanDiff
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localMean_le_bal.docstring:
**Local means by ball means**: let `r = ⌈R⌉₊`, so that `R < 2^r`. For every order `L`,
`1 ≤ p < ∞`, `f ∈ L_p`, almost every `x` and every level `j`,
`|k_{j+r+1} ⋆ f(x)| ≤ C d_j f(x)` with `C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.ballMeanConst`. Since
`k_{J+1} ⋆ f = (f - m_{2^J} ⋆ f) - (f - m_{2^(J+1)} ⋆ f)` with `J = j + r`, and each term
averages differences with steps `-2^(-J) z` or `-2^(-J-1) z`, `‖z‖ ≤ R`
(`Rd.ae_enorm_sub_conv_dilate_momentKernel_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtension_l.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtension_le_of_tlLocalNormOn
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtension_l.docstring:
**The local extension in `L_p`**: for `s > 0`,
`‖∑_j η_j ⋆ 1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ 2 ‖m‖_1 (1 - 2^(-s))⁻¹ X` with
`X = Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn` (`Rd.LocalMeansBump.tsum_enorm_localExtTerm_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtension_a.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtension_add_le_bumpExtensionConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtension_a.docstring:
**The bound of the local extension**: if the local means quasi-norm of Triebel–Lizorkin type
of `F` on `W` is finite and at most `C_b Y`, `C_b = Rd.LocalMeansBump.patchConst b p`, then the
local extension `E = ∑_j η_j ⋆ 1_W (k_j ⋆ F)` and every family of weak derivatives
`G_i = ∂_{e_i} E ∈ L_p(V)` satisfy `‖E‖_p + ∑_i ‖G_i‖_p ≤ C Y` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.bumpExtensionConst b p`
(`Rd.exists_hasWeakLineDeriv_of_memTriebelLizorkin`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtensionJe.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtensionJet_add_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtensionJe.docstring:
**The bound of the local extension of jets**: for the local extension `F` of a jet
`u = (f, (g_i)_i)` and weak derivatives `G_i = ∂_{e_i} F ∈ L_p(V)`,
`‖F‖_p + ∑_i ‖G_i‖_p ≤ C (‖f‖_{L_p(O)} + ∑_i ‖g_i‖_{L_p(O)})` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.bumpExtensionConst b p`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtension_add_le_bumpExtensionConst`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtTerm_le_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtTerm_le_of_forall_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_localExtTerm_le_.docstring:
**The terms of the local extension from a bound on the weighted local means**: if
`2^(js) ‖1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ X` for every `j`, then `‖η_j ⋆ 1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ 2 ‖m‖_1 2^(-js) X`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_le_tlLocalMeansN.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_le_tlLocalMeansNorm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_le_tlLocalMeansN.docstring:
**`L_p` norms by local means**: for `L ≥ 1`, `1 ≤ p < ∞`, `1 ≤ q ≤ ∞`, every `s` and
`f ∈ L_p`, `‖f‖_p ≤ 2 ‖m‖_1 (1 - 2^(-s))⁻¹ ‖f‖^{b,L}_{F^s_{p,q}}`: the reproducing formula
`f = ∑_j η_j ⋆ k_j ⋆ f` with `‖η_j‖_1 ≤ 2 ‖m‖_1` (`ENNReal.enorm_le_of_tendsto_sum`), then
`ℓ_∞(L_p) ≤ L_p(ℓ_∞) ≤ L_p(ℓ_q)` (`MeasureTheory.lqNorm_max_le_eLpNorm_lqNorm`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_indicatorLp_sub_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_indicatorLp_sub_convLp_scaledMoment_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_indicatorLp_sub_.docstring:
**Moment kernels approximate with the modulus on `T`**: if the steps take `W` into `T`,
`‖1_W (f - m_{2^j} ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ ‖g‖_1 ω_L(f, R 2^(-j), T)_p`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_indicatorLp_loca.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_indicatorLp_localMean_succ_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_indicatorLp_loca.docstring:
**Local means are bounded by the modulus on `T`**: for a bump of radius `R ≤ 1/2` whose steps
take `W` into `T`, `‖1_W (k_{j+1} ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ 2 ‖g‖_1 ω_L(f, 2^(-(j+1)), T)_p`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_indicatorLp_loca.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_indicatorLp_localMean_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_indicatorLp_loca.docstring:
The local means on `W` are bounded by the local means quasi-norm of Triebel–Lizorkin type:
`‖1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ 2^(-js) X` with `X = Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_dualK.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_dualKernel_le_mul
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_dualK.docstring:
**Differences of the dual kernels**: `|Δ^L_h η_i(y)| ≤ A_L 2^(in) 2^(iL) ‖h‖^L` with
`A_L = Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst L L`, the case of the step `h` without dilation in
`Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_dualKernel_le`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_dualK.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_dualKernel_le_indicator
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_dualK.docstring:
**Differences of the dual kernels for short steps**: for `i ≤ j` and `‖h‖ < 2^(-j)`,
`|Δ^L_h η_i| ≤ A_L 2^(in) 2^(-(j-i)L) 1_{B(0, (2LR + L + 1) 2^(-i))}`, since `η_i` vanishes
outside `B̄(0, 2LR 2^(-i))` and the points `y + l h`, `l ≤ L`, move by at most
`L 2^(-j) ≤ L 2^(-i)`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_dualK.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_dualKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_dualK.docstring:
**Differences of the dual kernels**, one step of the moment identity of `Φ`:
`|Δ^L'_{-2^(-j') z} η_i(w)| ≤ A 2^(in) 2^(iL') 2^(-j'L') ‖z‖^L'` with
`A = Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst L L'`, by the bound of differences through derivatives.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_conv_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_conv_dualKernel_le_of_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_higherDiff_conv_.docstring:
**Ball means of `η_i ⋆ g`, fine levels, one step**: for `i ≤ j`, a locally integrable `g`,
`‖h‖ < 2^(-j)` and every `x`,
`|Δ^L_h (η_i ⋆ g)(x)| ≤ A_L (2LR + L + 1)^n |B(0,1)| 2^(-(j-i)L) M|g|(x)`: the difference moves
onto the kernel (`Rd.higherDiff_conv_apply`), and a kernel bounded by a ball acts below the
maximal function (`Rd.lintegral_mul_le_maximalFunction_of_ball`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_dualKernel_le_in.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_dualKernel_le_indicator
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_dualKernel_le_in.docstring:
**The dual kernels are bounded with small support**:
`|η_i| ≤ A_0 2^(in) 1_{B(0, (2LR + 1) 2^(-i))}` with
`A_0 = Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst L 0`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel_level_le_of_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel.docstring:
**A coarse local mean of the atoms of one level**: for levels `i ≤ j`, smooth atoms
`a_{j,m}` on `V` of level `j` centred at the cells, with radius factor `d ≥ 0` and constant `A`,
and `f = ∑_m λ_{j,m} a_{j,m}` almost everywhere, `|k_i ⋆ f(x)| ≤ C M(x)` at every point, with
`M` the maximal function of the step function of the coefficients of level `j` and
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlAtomCoarseConst L d A`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel_le_tsum_level
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel.docstring:
**Local means of a sum of levels**: if `∑_{j ≤ J} f_j → F` in `L_p`, `1 ≤ p < ∞`, then
almost everywhere `|k_i ⋆ F(x)| ≤ ∑_j |k_i ⋆ f_j(x)|`: the local mean `k_i ⋆` is continuous on
`L_p`, and the bound holds for the partial sums
(`MeasureTheory.ae_enorm_le_of_tendsto_Lp`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel_dilatedBandKernel_le_of_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel.docstring:
**The support case**: for `j ≤ i` and every `y`,
`|(k_j ⋆ Θ_i)(y)| ≤ C 2^(jn) (1 + 2^j ‖y‖)^(-N)` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossBandSupportConst L N`: `k_j` is bounded by `2^(jn)` and supported
in `B̄(0, 2LR 2^(-j))`, and `Θ_i` has small tails.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel_dilatedBandKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_meansKernel.docstring:
**The cross kernel `k_j ⋆ Θ_i`**: for all levels `i, j` and almost every `y`,
`|(k_j ⋆ Θ_i)(y)| ≤ C c_{ji} 2^(min(i,j) n) (1 + 2^min(i,j) ‖y‖)^(-N)` with
`c_{ji} = 2^(-(j-i)L)` for `i ≤ j`, `c_{ji} = 1` for `i > j`, and
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossBandConst L N`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_lpBlockKern.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_lpBlockKernel_dualKernel_le_of_lt
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_lpBlockKern.docstring:
**The case `i > j`**: `|(ψ_j ⋆ η_i)(y)| ≤ C 2^(jn) (1 + 2^j ‖y‖)^(-N)` with
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualSupportConst L N`: `η_i` is supported in `B̄(0, 2LR 2^(-i))`, where
the Peetre weight at the scale `2^j` changes by at most `(1 + 2LR)^N`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_lpBlockKern.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_lpBlockKernel_dualKernel_le_of_le_one
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_lpBlockKern.docstring:
**The case `i ≤ j ≤ 1`**: `|(ψ_j ⋆ η_i)(y)| ≤ 2^(n+L') C 2^(-(j-i)L') 2^(in)
(1 + 2^i ‖y‖)^(-N)` with `C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualSupportConst L N`, as in the case `i > j`
with the Peetre weight at the scale `2^i`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_lpBlockKern.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_lpBlockKernel_dualKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_lpBlockKern.docstring:
**The cross kernel `ψ_j ⋆ η_i`**: for every order `L`, every `L' ≥ 1`, all levels `i, j` and
almost every `y`, `|(ψ_j ⋆ η_i)(y)| ≤ C c_{ji} 2^(min(i,j) n) (1 + 2^min(i,j) ‖y‖)^(-N)` with
`c_{ji} = 2^(-(j-i)L')` for `i ≤ j`, `c_{ji} = 1` for `i > j`, and
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualConst L L' N`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_dualKernel_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_dualKernel_le_maximalFunction
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_dualKernel_.docstring: `|η_i ⋆ g(x)| ≤ A_0 (2LR + 1)^n |B(0,1)| M|g|(x)` for every `g` and every `x`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_dualKernel_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_dualKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_dualKernel_.docstring: `|η_i ⋆ g(u)| ≤ A_0 2^(in) ∫_{B(u, (2LR + 1) 2^(-i))} |g|` for every `g` and every `u`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_conv_meansK.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_conv_meansKernel_dilatedBandKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_conv_meansK.docstring:
**One term of the block decomposition under a local mean**: for all levels `i, j`, every
function `h` and every `x`, `|((k_j ⋆ Θ_i) ⋆ h)(x)| ≤ C c_{ji} M|h|(x)` with
`c_{ji} = 2^(-(j-i)L)` for `i ≤ j`, `c_{ji} = 1` for `i > j`, and
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.localMeansByBlockConst L`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_conv_lpBloc.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_conv_lpBlockKernel_dualKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_conv_conv_lpBloc.docstring:
**One term of the reproducing formula under a block**: for `L' ≥ 1`, all levels `i, j`, every
function `h` and every `x`, `|((ψ_j ⋆ η_i) ⋆ h)(x)| ≤ C c_{ji} M|h|(x)` with
`c_{ji} = 2^(-(j-i)L')` for `i ≤ j`, `c_{ji} = 1` for `i > j`, and
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.blockByLocalMeansConst L L'`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_blockFun_le_tsum.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_blockFun_le_tsum_maximalFunction_of_tendsto
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_blockFun_le_tsum.docstring:
**The blocks of a synthesis sum, pointwise**: if `F = ∑_i η_i ⋆ h_i` in `L_p` (as the limit
of the partial sums), then for `L' ≥ 1`, almost everywhere and for all levels `j`,
`|ψ_j ⋆ F(x)| ≤ C ∑_i c_{ji} M|h_i|(x)` with `c_{ji} = 2^(-(j-i)L')` for `i ≤ j`, `c_{ji} = 1` for
`i > j`, and `C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.blockByLocalMeansConst L L'`
(`MeasureTheory.ae_enorm_le_of_tendsto_Lp`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_blockFun_le_tsum.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_blockFun_le_tsum_maximalFunction
Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_blockFun_le_tsum.docstring:
**The blocks by local means, pointwise**: for `L ≥ 1`, `L' ≥ 1`, `1 ≤ p < ∞` and
`f ∈ L_p`, almost everywhere and for all levels `j`,
`|ψ_j ⋆ f(x)| ≤ C ∑_i c_{ji} M(k_i ⋆ f)(x)` with `c_{ji} = 2^(-(j-i)L')` for `i ≤ j`,
`c_{ji} = 1` for `i > j`, and `C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.blockByLocalMeansConst L L'`. The reproducing
formula `f = ∑_i η_i ⋆ k_i ⋆ f` holds in `L_p`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_blockFun_le_tsum_maximalFunction_of_tendsto`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_lqNorm_conv_di.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_lqNorm_conv_divKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_lqNorm_conv_di.docstring:
The square functions of the divergence kernels: for `1 < p < ∞`,
`‖ x ↦ ‖(((K_i)_{2^j} ⋆ 1_T g)(x))_j‖_{ℓ_2} ‖_p ≤ C_p(K_i) ‖g‖_{L_p(T)}`
(`Rd.IsCZFamily.eLpNorm_lqNorm_conv_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_higherDiff_sca.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_higherDiff_scaledMoment_le_dyadic
Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_higherDiff_sca.docstring:
One dilated kernel at a scale at most `2^j`: `‖Δ_v^L m_{2^l}‖_1 ≤ C 2^(-(i-j)L)` for
`l ≤ j ≤ i` and `‖v‖ ≤ 2^(-i)`, and `≤ C` always.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_higherDiff_sca.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_higherDiff_scaledMoment_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_higherDiff_sca.docstring:
**Differences of the dilated moment kernels in `L_1`**:
`‖Δ_v^L m_{2^j}‖_1 ≤ (2^j ‖v‖)^L ‖D^L m‖_1`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_higherDiff_dua.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_higherDiff_dualKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_higherDiff_dua.docstring:
**Differences of the dual kernels in `L_1`**: for `‖v‖ ≤ 2^(-i)`,
`‖Δ_v^L η_j‖_1 ≤ C 2^(-(i-j)L)` if `j ≤ i`, and `‖Δ_v^L η_j‖_1 ≤ C` if `j > i`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_dyadicWeight_m.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_dyadicWeight_mul_conv_meansKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.eLpNorm_dyadicWeight_m.docstring:
**The weighted local means in `L_p`** (Young's inequality):
`‖2^(js) |k_j ⋆ f|‖_p ≤ 2^(js) 2 ‖m‖_1 ‖f‖_p`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.dyadicWeight_mul_enorm.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.dyadicWeight_mul_enorm_indicatorLp_localMean_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.dyadicWeight_mul_enorm.docstring:
The weighted local means on `W` are bounded by the local means quasi-norm of Triebel–Lizorkin
type: `2^(js) ‖1_W (k_j ⋆ f)‖_p ≤ X` with `X = Rd.LocalMeansBump.tlLocalNormOn`
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.enorm_indicatorLp_localMean_le`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.dyadicWeight_mul_enorm.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.dyadicWeight_mul_enorm_conv_meansKernel_le
Rd.LocalMeansBump.dyadicWeight_mul_enorm.docstring:
**One local mean by the gradient**: under the hypotheses of
`Rd.LocalMeansBump.conv_meansKernel_two_succ_eq`,
`2^(j+1) |(k_{j+1} ⋆ 1_T f)(x)| ≤ 2 ∑_i |((K_i)_{2^j} ⋆ 1_T g_i)(x)|`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualTailConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualTailConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualTailConst_ne_top.docstring: The constant of the averaged differences of the dual kernels is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualTailConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualTailConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualTailConst.docstring:
The constant `A 4^L' (8L')^N (1 + 4LR)^N T` of the averaged differences of the dual kernels,
with `A = Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst L L'` and `T = Rd.tailConst lpKernelS L' N`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualKernel_eq_zero_of_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualKernel_eq_zero_of_lt
Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualKernel_eq_zero_of_.docstring: The dual kernels vanish outside `B̄(0, 2 L R 2^(-j))`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualKernel_eq_zero.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualKernel_eq_zero
Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualKernel_eq_zero.docstring: The dual kernels vanish outside the ball of radius `L R`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst_nonneg.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst_nonneg
Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst_nonneg.docstring: The constant of the derivatives of the dual kernels is nonnegative.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst.docstring:
The constant `A = 2 ∑_{l ≤ K} sup ‖D^l m‖` of the derivatives of the dual kernels, where the
suprema of the derivatives of the moment kernel `m` are its Schwartz seminorms.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualConst_ne_top.docstring: The constant of the differences of the dual kernels is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualConst.docstring: The constant `2 (‖D^L m‖_1 + 2^L ‖m‖_1)` of the differences of the dual kernels.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.divKernel_eq_zero.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.divKernel_eq_zero
Rd.LocalMeansBump.divKernel_eq_zero.docstring:
The divergence kernels vanish at `y` if the moment kernel vanishes at every `t y`,
`t ∈ [1, 2]`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.divKernel.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.divKernel
Rd.LocalMeansBump.divKernel.docstring:
The **divergence kernels** `K_i` of a bump: the divergence kernels (`Rd.divergenceSchwartz`) of
its moment kernel `m` of order two in the directions of the orthonormal basis `e_i = Rd.gridBasis`,
so that `∑_i ∂_{e_i} K_i = m_2 - m` (`Rd.sum_lineDerivOp_divergenceSchwartz`); at the dyadic scales
this writes the local means kernels as divergences
(`Rd.LocalMeansBump.meansKernel_two_succ_apply`).

Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffUpperConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffUpperConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffUpperConst_ne_top.docstring:
The constant of the bound of the ball means quasi-norm by local means is finite for
`1 < p < ∞`, `1 < q ≤ ∞` and `0 < s < L`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffUpperConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffUpperConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffUpperConst.docstring:
The constant `2 ‖m‖_1 (1 - 2^(-s))⁻¹ + C A_{s,L} C_{FS}` of the bound of the ball means
quasi-norm by local means: `‖m‖_1` is the `L_1` norm of the moment kernel,
`C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffByLocalMeansConst L`, `A_{s,L} = ENNReal.almostDiagonalConst s L` and
`C_{FS} = Rd.feffermanSteinConst V p q`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffLowerConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffLowerConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffLowerConst_ne_top.docstring: The constant of the bound of the local means quasi-norm by ball means is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffLowerConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffLowerConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffLowerConst.docstring:
The constant `2 ‖m‖_1 ∑_{j ≤ r} 2^(js) + 2^((r+1)s) C` of the bound of the local means
quasi-norm by ball means, with `r = ⌈R⌉₊` and `C = Rd.LocalMeansBump.ballMeanConst`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffByLocalMeansConst_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffByLocalMeansConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffByLocalMeansConst_.docstring: The constant of the bound of ball means by local means is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffByLocalMeansConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffByLocalMeansConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.diffByLocalMeansConst.docstring:
The constant `|B(0,1)| max(A_L (2LR + L + 1)^n, 2^L A_0 (2LR + 1)^n (2LR + L + 1)^n)` of
the bound of ball means by local means, with `A_l = Rd.LocalMeansBump.dualDerivConst L l`, the
bound of the derivatives of order `≤ l` of the dual kernels.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.derivNorm.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.derivNorm
Rd.LocalMeansBump.derivNorm.docstring: The `L_1` norm of the derivatives of order `L` of the moment kernel.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualSupportConst_.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualSupportConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualSupportConst_.docstring: The constant of the support cases of `ψ_j ⋆ η_i` is finite.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualSupportConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualSupportConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualSupportConst.docstring:
The constant `C (1 + 2LR)^N 2 ‖m‖_1` of the support cases of `ψ_j ⋆ η_i`, with
`C = Rd.lpBlockKernelDecayConst V N`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualConst_ne_top.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualConst_ne_top
Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualConst_ne_top.docstring: The constant of the cross kernel `ψ_j ⋆ η_i` is finite for `N > n`.

Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualConst.name: Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualConst
Rd.LocalMeansBump.crossDualConst.docstring:
